name: bg_test
prompt: Wide night-time background painting for a slot machine game, 16:9. A lonely American roadside gas station and convenience store at night called FALCOS. Big red neon sign on the store front reading exactly "FALCOS" in bold retro script, glowing hot red. Flat canopy over two old gas pumps on the left, a convenience store with lit windows full of snack shelves, cracked asphalt with oil stains, a payphone, an ice chest, puddles reflecting the red neon, a deep blue-black sky. The centre of the picture is the store front, kept fairly simple because the game board sits on top of it. Style: high-end hand-inked cartoon illustration, bold confident black outlines with varied line weight, rich painterly shading, fine texture (concrete grain, rust, peeling paint), cinematic night lighting with red neon glow and cool sodium-blue fill. No people, no cars, no other text.
